discrepancies.reference_text: ഇപ്പൊ വയസ്സ് കുറവായില്ലേ. ഇപ്പൊ ഒന്നും സ്ഥിരം ഒന്നും പനിയൊന്നുമില്ല.
discrepancies.translation_text: it has been a long time, about ten years, I don't have any permanent work now
discrepancies.explanation: The reference says 'I am young now, I don't have permanent work (panikal) now', but the translation mistranslates it as 'it has been a long time, about ten years'.
The reference says 'Tricks/mischief are plenty anyway', but the translation mistranslates 'Tharikida' (tricks) as 'consideration'.
The reference says 'eeshwara vishwasam' (faith in God), but the translation mistranslates 'eeshwara' as 'Jesus'.

discrepancies.reference_text: എന്റെ ടൈം ഏതാണ്ട് ആയി. പൈസ പോണു.
discrepancies.translation_text: So my child, I should send an order, my time is almost up, it can be done. Money should go.
discrepancies.explanation: The translation adds extra phrases like 'my child, I should send an order' and 'it can be done' which are not in the reference.
